mistake_reason: At step 13, the Assistant relied on an ambiguous summary phrase ("remaining candidates are missing one or more required items") and assumed all non-fully-qualified applicants were missing exactly one qualification (computing 31 - 17 = 14). The Assistant did not ask for clarification or request complete distribution details from FileSurfer, despite evidence that several applicants had Missing Count >1. This is a failure to ask for clarification under uncertainty, fitting FM-2.2 (proceeding with assumptions instead of verifying incomplete/truncated data).
